content:
maddie: Hey sec team — need short just-in-time access to run kubectl port-forward against staging to repro a customer-only bug. Requesting 30m. JIRA INF-2483.
ana: Can you paste the exact command and why we can't use existing debug proxies?
maddie: command is:
```
kubectl port-forward svc/payment-api 8080:80 -n staging
```
It's to hit the payment callback locally and capture headers + response timing. Can't repro through proxy due to SNI differences. No DB or secrets will be touched.
ben: Will you be viewing any PII in responses? Need scope defined before we approve. cc @security-bot for audit.
maddie: No PII expected — just status, headers, and a small JSON response with order id (hashed). I'll redact order ids before saving.
security-bot: Reminder: use the JIT portal or file a break-glass ticket. Audit will record the session and who approved.
maddie: Filed JIT token JIT-73421 and linked in INF-2483: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2483. Start target: 2024-03-01T13:10Z, duration 30m.
ana: OK I approve 30 minutes for service account dev-maddie-sa scoped to port-forward to svc/payment-api in staging only. No DB dumps, no log exports.
devops-lead: I'll provision ephemeral role now and attach session via session-manager. Will post session id.
ben: Also please run from your workstation with `REDACT_OUTPUT=true` env and avoid piping raw responses to disk.
maddie: ack. running from laptop and will redact. starting when ephemeral creds show up.
devops-lead: ephemeral role created. session id ssm-20240301-xyz. creds expire in 30m.
maddie: Starting port-forward now with session id ssm-20240301-xyz. Will ping when finished.
ana: Please remember to scrub any captured snippets before sharing. :thumbsup:
maddie: Done — session complete, access revoked. session id ssm-20240301-xyz. I captured one header sample, redacted order ids, deleted raw output after triage. Closing INF-2483 with notes. Thanks all.
security-bot: Audit logged: session ssm-20240301-xyz, approver ana, requester maddie, duration 30m.
